mentions.name: Texcraft
mentions.description: This project re-implements TeX with a modular, LLVM-style software architecture. It includes web UIs (a hyphenation viewer and a lig/kern viewer) built from the same Texcraft code that has identical behavior to TeX, illustrating TeX's inner workings; the lig/kern UI is still missing instructions. The project has also surfaced at least one bug in Knuth's TeX, being written up.
mentions.source_excerpt: Texcraft is an attempt to re-implement TeX with a modular/LLVM software architecture. These UIs take the same code in Texcraft that has identical behavior to TeX, and illustrates some of the inner workings of TeX. The lig/kern one is missing instructions :)
